title: Implement Command Orchestrator State Schema
description: Schema for workflow_state maintained by /implement command orchestrator during task execution. Tracks execution progress, task statuses, and failure recovery state.

current_plan.description: Current plan being executed (e.g., '001-infrastructure-foundation'). Null when no plan is active.

completed_tasks.description: List of task IDs that have been completed successfully

in_progress_tasks.description: List of task IDs currently being executed by agents

blocked_tasks.description: List of task IDs that are blocked due to failures or unmet dependencies

iterations_attempted.description: Number of retry iterations attempted (max 3 per review checkpoint policy)

last_failure_reason.description: Description of the most recent failure reason

blocking_issues.description: List of unresolved blocking issues that prevent review from passing

failed_review_groups.description: Review groups that failed after maximum retry attempts (3 iterations)

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution started (e.g., '2025-10-17T10:00:00Z')

elapsed_hours.description: Total elapsed time in hours since execution started

execution_mode.description: Execution mode from command flags. Controls orchestrator behavior and workflow phases.

execution_metadata.description: Additional metadata about the execution context

plans_discovered.description: Total number of plans discovered in Phase 1 (Discovery)

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks across all plans

total_estimated_hours.description: Sum of estimated_hours from all tasks in TASKS.json files

execution_order.description: Ordered list of plan names to execute based on dependency graph

skip_phase.description: Phase number to skip (from --skip-phase flag). Null if no phase skipped.

target_plan.description: Specific plan number to execute (from --plan flag). Null for full execution.
